summary: Very steep short kerb with a house 8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 8 m, 13 m and 23 m away on the kerb's own side; fully overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street, kerb against fences and trees; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just below a busy road junction.
drivers.convention: One car parked further down; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 22% grade, over the 12% limit
sun_shade: Street trees shade the east kerb; open from the west.
